card: [Character Artist] First set: the other 8 characters

tasks.brief: Generate concept sketches for the eight new African American characters, ensuring diversity in facial features, hairstyles, and body types while maintaining consistency with the established art style.
Develop detailed character designs for each of the eight characters, including skin tone, hair texture, facial structure, and unique visual traits, based on the approved concept sketches.
Create full-color, high-resolution renderings of each character in a standard standing pose, with consistent lighting and background to ensure visual uniformity across the set.
Assign unique, non-repeating names to each character, ensuring no conflicts with existing names in the game’s database, particularly avoiding duplicates like Darnell.
Compile all eight character assets into a single deliverable package with labeled files, including renderings, color palettes, and style guides, ready for David’s review on the Characters tab.
